Welcome to Berat, Albania – the famous “Town of a Thousand Windows”
In this video, we explore one of Albania’s most beautiful and historic towns, known for its Ottoman-era architecture, white houses with countless windows, and rich cultural heritage.
Berat is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the top places to visit in Albania. From stunning hilltop views to charming old streets, this travel vlog showcases why Berat is often called the most photogenic town in Albania.
